app.name: ReturnZap
app.short_description: View customer return details from ReturnZap inside Zendesk tickets.
app.long_description: ReturnZap helps e-commerce merchants manage product returns. This app displays a customer's recent returns — including stage, shipping, tracking, items, and exchange information — in the Zendesk Support ticket sidebar, so agents have full context without switching tools.
app.installation_instructions:
1. In ReturnZap HQ, go to Settings → Integrations → Zendesk and click Connect.
2. Copy the API token shown.
3. Paste the token below when prompted.

api_token.label: ReturnZap API Token
api_token.helpText: Find this in ReturnZap → Settings → Integrations → Zendesk.
